implementation.input_contract: One immutable Wave2 Q1 submission journal containing at least one returned, unique Slurm JobID and a matching jobs_submitted count.
properties: Reads active state from squeue and terminal allocation state from sacct.
Ignores sacct step rows such as .batch and .extern.
Prefers the active squeue row while a job is pending or running.
Treats an unobserved JobID as UNKNOWN and non-terminal.
Refuses to overwrite an existing snapshot.
Submits, cancels, requeues, and modifies no Slurm job.

verification.real_snapshot_reason: No authorized Wave2 Q1 submission journal and no live Wave2 JobID exist yet. A synthetic status record was deliberately not presented as runtime evidence.

after_authorized_submission: Persist every JobID through the durable submission journal.
Use a long bounded wait against those exact JobIDs.
After a timeout, interruption, or state change, write a new immutable squeue+sacct snapshot.
Continue observing the same JobIDs; never restart solely because the observation wait expired.
Only collect Q1 results after every expected JobID has a terminal allocation state and its run artifacts are present.

claim_boundary: Read-only monitoring preparation only. No job was submitted or monitored and no scientific result is claimed.
